b1-mariaterezia-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Resettlement Interview
b1-mariaterezia-01.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview. The examiner asks how the country was populated again after the Ottoman wars. You answer that the court of Vienna called settlers in, and that the settlers' work made the empty land live again.
b1-mariaterezia-01.prompt: Tell the examiner how the empty land was settled again.
cues: Say what the settlers' work did
b1-mariaterezia-01.target: A bécsi udvar telepeseket hívott az országba. A telepesek munkája révén újra élet lett a puszta vidékeken.
b1-mariaterezia-01.english: The court of Vienna called settlers into the country. Through the settlers' work there was life again in the empty regions.
b1-mariaterezia-01.canDo: I can say how and why the country was repopulated after the Ottoman wars.

b1-mariaterezia-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Diet of Pozsony
b1-mariaterezia-02.scenario: A guide at the museum of Pozsony asks you how Maria Theresa won the support of the Hungarian nobles in 1741. You answer with what you learned for the citizenship interview.
b1-mariaterezia-02.prompt: Tell the guide what the nobles did for the queen in 1741.
cues: Say how they confirmed their support
Say it is only a tradition
b1-mariaterezia-02.target: A nemesek katonai segítséget ajánlottak a királynőnek, és hűségesküvel erősítették meg a támogatásukat. A hagyomány szerint kardot rántottak.
b1-mariaterezia-02.english: The nobles offered military help to the queen and confirmed their support with an oath of fealty. According to tradition they drew their swords.
b1-mariaterezia-02.canDo: I can tell how Maria Theresa became ruler and what happened at the Diet of Pozsony in 1741.

b1-mariaterezia-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Queen's Decrees
b1-mariaterezia-03.scenario: A history teacher asks you in class what the Urbárium and the Ratio Educationis were. You are practising for the citizenship interview.
b1-mariaterezia-03.prompt: Tell your teacher what each decree regulated.
cues: Say what the Ratio Educationis regulated
Say who had to keep the rules
b1-mariaterezia-03.target: Az Urbárium a jobbágyok szolgáltatásait szabályozta, a Ratio Educationis az iskolákat. A földesurak kötelesek voltak betartani a szabályokat.
b1-mariaterezia-03.english: The Urbarium regulated the serfs' services, the Ratio Educationis the schools. The landlords were obliged to keep the rules.
b1-mariaterezia-03.canDo: I can name the Urbárium and the Ratio Educationis and say what each regulated.

b1-mariaterezia-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Hatted King
b1-mariaterezia-04.scenario: On a visit to the Hungarian National Museum a guide asks why Joseph II is called the hatted king. You answer, and also say what he did with the language.
b1-mariaterezia-04.prompt: Tell the guide why Joseph II was called the hatted king.
cues: Say what he did not do
Say what language he made official
b1-mariaterezia-04.target: Nem koronáztatta meg magát, ezért hívták kalapos királynak. Annak ellenére, hogy a nemesek tiltakoztak, a németet tette hivatalos nyelvvé.
b1-mariaterezia-04.english: He did not have himself crowned, so they called him the hatted king. Although the nobles protested, he made German the official language.
b1-mariaterezia-04.canDo: I can explain why Joseph II was called the hatted king.

b1-mariaterezia-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Language Movement
b1-mariaterezia-05.scenario: In the citizenship interview the examiner asks about the national awakening of the late 18th century. You answer with a writer and a newspaper.
b1-mariaterezia-05.prompt: Tell the examiner who started the language movement and what appeared.
b1-mariaterezia-05.target: Bessenyei György sürgette a magyar nyelv használatát. 1780-ban megjelent az első magyar nyelvű újság, és a nemzeti ébredés előkészítette a reformkort.
b1-mariaterezia-05.english: György Bessenyei urged the use of the Hungarian language. In 1780 the first Hungarian-language newspaper appeared, and the national awakening prepared the reform age.
b1-mariaterezia-05.canDo: I can tell how the movement for the Hungarian language grew in the late 18th century.

b1-mariaterezia-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The 18th Century in Review
b1-mariaterezia-consolidation.scenario: The examiner at the citizenship interview asks you to summarise the 18th century in a few sentences.
b1-mariaterezia-consolidation.prompt: Tell the examiner what changed in the 18th century.
cues: Say who came to the country
b1-mariaterezia-consolidation.target: A 18. században sok telepes érkezett az országba. Mária Terézia rendelettel szabályozta a robotot, II. József pedig a németet tette hivatalossá.
b1-mariaterezia-consolidation.english: In the 18th century many settlers came to the country. Maria Theresa regulated the corvée by decree, and Joseph II made German official.
b1-mariaterezia-consolidation.canDo: I can synthesize 18th-century repopulation, Maria Theresa's reforms, and Joseph II's reign.
